title: angelica glabra
intro: Angelica glabra, commonly known as Smooth Angelica, is a perennial plant in the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote digestive health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of various diseases due to its health benefits, which include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Smooth Angelica include stimulating digestion, relieving menstrual cramps, and soothing respiratory issues. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional Chinese medicine.
